body.label: Effect
body.html: Partially phase yourself or one ally within 4 units. The target may move 2 units through occupied spaces or narrow gaps and gains +1 Defense during that movement.

surges.html: Transfer 1 damage from one affected ally to yourself after this Action resolves.
If this Action affects an ally, that ally gains +1 Defense until its next turn.

rider.title: PHANTOM — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 4 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 2 additional Mana to fully manifest your Phantom.
